Specification: This module builds and optionally writes out a TLA+ counterexample artifact to a file. It derives a module text string from the configured counterexample file name and the value of a `CounterExample` object, then conditionally serializes that generated text depending on whether the counterexample has any state and whether console output is enabled. The specification is a utility-style module rather than a transition-system model: it defines helper operators over values, uses LET-bound names, record and tuple expressions, string concatenation, and an IF-THEN-ELSE condition, but it does not declare state variables, actions, temporal behaviors, or fault-tolerance properties.
IfThenElse: IF CounterExample.state = {} \/ ("console" \in DOMAIN CounterExample /\ CounterExample["console"] = FALSE) THEN TRUE ELSE /\ Serialize(_TLAPlusCounterExampleModule, _TLAPlusCounterExampleFile, [format |-> "TXT", charset |-> "UTF-8", openOptions |-> <<"WRITE", "CREATE", "TRUNCATE_EXISTING">>]).exitValue = 0 /\ PrintT("CounterExample written: " \o _TLAPlusCounterExampleFile)
